scope: Current evidence for KUSTO usefulness on real bathymetry / acoustic-backscatter / cross-survey marine data. This ledger separates formal validation, robustness support, case-level recovery, and blocked tests.

nonpromotion_evidence.finding: Bathymetry candidates retained backscatter enrichment after excluding a zero-MAD metric, but the correction was posthoc and cannot validate the method.
Cross-channel enrichment transferred without the zero-MAD pathology, but a frozen tile-radius stratum lacked scoreable backscatter coverage, so the preregistered primary test was blocked.

Blind bathymetry candidates were frozen, but backscatter controls were degenerate because native nodata metadata did not define a usable acquisition support domain. This failure motivated paired-support-domain v2; Cross Sound is calibration-only for that change.

The blind detector recovered the ROV-confirmed natural rock feature in EX1903L2 within about 18 m, but missed it under frozen selection in EX1203 and EX1805 despite local soundings; no cross-survey recovery was established.
ScienceBase did not support byte-range acquisition for 0.6-0.8 GB archives; no numeric detector result was taken.

utility_now_supported: KUSTO can generate bathymetric morphology candidates that are statistically enriched for independently held-out acoustic-backscatter structure on at least two genuinely unseen real datasets.
The enrichment result has replicated across an inland-lake corpus and a marine coral-reef corpus.

The pipeline can preserve blocked and negative outcomes and has exposed concrete portability failures involving zero-MAD statistics, coverage strata, support-domain semantics, and extreme-tail selection.
KUSTO can be used as a prioritization layer for where additional independent sonar, imagery, ROV, or survey replay is worth spending effort.
next_required_expansion: Run paired-support-domain v2 unchanged on additional unseen marine datasets from different instruments and regions.
Build a >=20 target known-object benchmark with hidden truth for localization and target-versus-control enrichment.
Continue independent-survey replay separately from same-survey cross-channel validation.
Bind candidate locations to ROV/still/video tracks only after frozen candidate generation.
Expand beyond NOAA/USGS to EMODnet and AusSeabed source-resolved products without using composite grids as independent validation of their source surveys.
